hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted palette (warm peach/green circles) and clean card chrome show design effort, but the visualization is cropped at the bottom and the dense dark edge bundles become illegible against the layered translucent fills.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Relational/hierarchical viz with no bar or area charts avoids baseline issues; force-layout radius correctly uses scaleSqrt with d3.extent domain, data joins carry key functions (d.id), and no magnitude-encoding violations found.
flags: Update Storm - tension slider calls redrawLinks() on every input event; the guard `svg.selectAll('.transitioning').empty()` is dead code since '.transitioning' is never set, so protection is always bypassed
Update Storm - force simulation tick fires redrawLinks() and redrawHierarchyLinks() at 60fps with no RAF coalescing or dirty-flag pattern
Mid-Flight Snap - no explicit .interrupt() call before svg.transition() in updateLayout(); clicking a new layout mid-animation relies on implicit D3 interruption without syncing node state
Mid-Flight Snap - easing param sliders use .on('input', () => updateLayout(currentLayout)) with no debounce, firing a fresh 1500ms transition on every slider tick during rapid scrubbing

Stale Closure - on('interrupt') handler only updates FPS display; d.current_x/d.current_y are not explicitly committed on interrupt, so a rapid layout switch may seed the next transition from a stale source position if the tween hasn't yet written the final frame
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The visualization has no infinite feedback loops or cross-view dispatchers, but suffers from an un-throttled tension slider (dead guard), un-debounced easing-param re-transitions, missing .interrupt() calls, and force-tick link redraws at full 60fps without RAF coalescing.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Three-color cluster structure reads clearly at a glance, but the dense edge bundles converging at the center form a dark tangle that makes individual connections unreadable; the heavy control panel (8 layout buttons, 4 checkboxes, easing selector, FPS meter) adds UI cognitive overhead on top of an already complex chart.
